How do I start a return or an exchange?
Returns are self-serve. Start one through our returns portal with your order number and the email on the order: https://www.quadlockcase.net/pages/returns
If you're after an exchange, the path depends on what you need. If you have a phone case for the wrong phone model, tell me which phone you have now. You return the item there and place a fresh order for the one you want.

turns.replyTail:
ay for return shipping?

says:
Return shipping is at your cost, but you don't pay anything up front. Once you submit your return through the portal, a prepaid return label is emailed to you. A $9.99 flat-rate return shipping fee is then deducted from your refund once the item reaches us.

Returns are mail-only, so there are no in-person drop-offs. Refunds are processed after we've received and inspected the item, and that can take up to about two weeks.
